```{r setup-mascot_gestures, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_gestures-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_gestures")
```

```{r mascot_gestures-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(paste0(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "'s gestures"), "Gestures")
```

<div class="pg-muted">

frames is the length of the movement that plays, at 30 frames per second. A gesture whose parts are missing
plays its fallback.

</div>

```{r mascot_gestures-table, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) guide_table(mascot::mascot_gestures(ch)))
```

```{r mascot_gestures-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_gestures", studio_character)
```
